newsitem.title: USA: Pepsi PR does not expect Q4 return to profit.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi PR does not expect Q4 return to profit.

text.p: Pepsi-Cola Bottling Co said on Tuesday that it does not expect to return to profitibility during the fourth quarter due to continuing pricing pressures in the Puerto Rican soft drink market.
The company disclosed its forecast in a 10Q filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The company also cited production and volume interruptions and start-up costs associated with the opening of the Tao Baja plant and expected losses by BAESA in its fourth quarter results, the filing said.

In connection with efforts being made to improve the profitability of BAESA, in which the company owns about 17 percent, the transfer of voting control from essential shareholders to PepsiCo occurred on July 1, 1996, the filing said.
